admin.limit_help: How many similar discussions to show, at most (1–20). If nothing is similar enough, nothing is shown.
admin.max_age: Ignore discussions inactive for longer than (days)
admin.max_age_help: Leave at 0 to include discussions of any age.
admin.extra_stopwords_help: Words too common on your forum to say two titles are alike: your sport, your town, your product's name. Separate them with spaces or commas. Common English words like "the", "best" and "question" are already ignored.
admin.sidebar: Also show in the discussion sidebar on wide screens
admin.sidebar_help: A compact copy under the discussion controls. With this on, the list loads with the page on wide screens instead of waiting until the reader nears the end.
